issues.desc: CHK-001 is phrased as an internal implementation step rather than a user-observable acceptance item. Reframe it around the observable contract: multiple independent agent-liveness child smokes overlap under a fixed maximum concurrency while visible output, failure/signal reporting, recursion prevention, and cleanup remain unchanged; leave the pool mechanism as context. CHK-002 can then remain the distinct cold-suite budget proof.

CHK-001 is implementation-mechanics-only: it says to replace the serial loop with a bounded pool and preserve internals, but does not state the user-observable outcome. Reframe or extend it so a maintainer can observe that the agent-liveness suite runs multiple independent child smokes concurrently while retaining the same visible output, failure reporting, and cleanup behavior.
